description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katukurunduwatta, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521005
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of numerous land parcels under the Registration of Title Act, with a detailed schedule listing parcel numbers, extents, owners (National Housing Development Authority), and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and deals specifically with land registration and property rights, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
